reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
sizes AS (  -- one row per cohort month
  SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users
  FROM cohort
  GROUP BY cohort_month
),
paid AS (  -- one row per cohort user and month with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id, c.cohort_month,
         date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE)) AS month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT z.cohort_month, k.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN z.cohort_month + INTERVAL (k.month_offset) MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(pd.user_id) / z.cohort_users END AS paying_share
FROM sizes z
CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
LEFT JOIN paid pd ON pd.cohort_month = z.cohort_month AND pd.month_offset = k.month_offset
GROUP BY z.cohort_month, k.month_offset, z.cohort_users

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
grid AS (  -- one row per cohort month and month offset from 0 to 3
  SELECT DISTINCT c.cohort_month, g.month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 3) AS g(month_offset)
)
SELECT g.cohort_month, g.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN g.cohort_month + INTERVAL (g.month_offset) MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id)
                        FROM cohort c
                        JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
                        JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
                        WHERE c.cohort_month = g.cohort_month AND NOT p.refunded
                          AND date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = g.month_offset)
                 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c WHERE c.cohort_month = g.cohort_month) END AS paying_share
FROM grid g

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', signup_ts)) AS DATE) AS cm FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
sz AS (SELECT cm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c GROUP BY cm),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.cm, c.user_id,
         date_diff('month', c.cm, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', pay.paid_at)) AS DATE)) AS mo
  FROM c JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  JOIN payments pay ON pay.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT pay.refunded
)
SELECT sz.cm AS cohort_month, k.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN CAST(sz.cm + to_months(CAST(k.month_offset AS INTEGER)) AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(p.user_id) / sz.n END AS paying_share
FROM sz CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
LEFT JOIN p ON p.cm = sz.cm AND p.mo = k.month_offset
GROUP BY sz.cm, k.month_offset, sz.n
